verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs explicitly show a Two-Factor plugin with TOTP authenticator-app setup as default, plus backup code generation for account recovery, and a straightforward enable/verify API (twoFactor.enable) — covering the core TOTP+backup-code MFA requirement. However, there is no documented mechanism specifically for step-up authentication (re-prompting MFA for sensitive actions) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit step-up/re-auth enforcement documentation or examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of the 2FA flow beyond docs.
